about: Leohpaz's sounds the game plays (PIX-411, PIX-413): for each event in assets/data/audio.json, its takes as [the bundle's zip, the file's path inside it, how to cut it], or the name of the event whose takes it shares. tools/sound_prep.py reads them out of the zips, cuts each ("keep": the source's seconds after its start, the tail faded; "loop": a bed's seconds, its end crossfaded into its start; "pitch", "lowpass" Hz, "db" after levelling), levels it to its family at its family's rate (PIX-415: a bed's and the hero's fall's too, no longer lowered to fit) and writes <event>_<n>.wav and takes.json into the private pixelheim-assets repo (retro-rpg/leohpaz/pixelheim/); scripts/fetch-private-art.sh installs them, git-ignored, into assets/audio/paid/, where they stand in for the event's own takes. The packs may not be redistributed, so no take enters this repo. Picked by name and measured from ~/playground/leohpaz-sfx/mapping, never heard: the PR's listening list says which to hear first. No take that may hold words (the game speaks English and French).
